name: Evidence-Gated Allocator
description: One evidence-gated methodology run as three market flows: a Korean sleeve, a US sleeve, and the allocator that sets their budgets and proposes the cross-market rebalance. The flows are subagents of one manager; only the orchestrator submits.

capabilities.reason: Current holdings, weights and cash are the denominator for every sizing and concentration judgement.
Existing claims and falsifiable invalidation conditions are checked before any holding or candidate is changed.
Prior source observations are inspected by id so research can be verified without copying raw evidence into private memory.
Book-wide regime, sector and entry-hold conclusions are read separately from asset theses.
A changed portfolio-wide conclusion is recorded as a revision rather than hidden in private memory.
This instance reads lens sample counts, calibration and repeated failure patterns from earlier runs.
Meaningful new closed outcomes and coverage changes create append-only revisions to stable learning keys.
Toss market data, SEC filings, Alpaca news and corporate actions, and OpenDART receipts and statements are checked as independent vendor evidence; configured OpenBB/FMP history may supplement bars.
